rows.grounds: instrumental of compound vacā (sweet flag) and kalka (paste), indicating the writing substance
object of the act of writing
absolutive expressing the completed act prior to subsequent ritual use
locative of compound bhānu (sun) and vāsara (day), specifying Sunday as the time

items.question: What substance and timing are prescribed for ritually inscribing the mantra?
premises: The mantra is to be ritually written down.
Sweet-flag paste serves as the prescribed writing substance.
Sunday is the prescribed day for the inscription.
items.inference: Ritual inscription of the mantra requires writing it with sweet-flag paste on a Sunday.
items.plain_english: But having written the mantra with sweet-flag paste on a Sunday.
